---
title: "Samples"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
from itables import show
from IPython.display import HTML, display

df = pd.read_csv("Samples.csv")
display(HTML('<div data-pagefind-body style="display:none">' + df.to_html(index=False, escape=True)    + '</div>'))

df.insert(0, "#", range(1, len(df) + 1))
df['non_human_reads'] = "<a href=https://data.idies.jhu.edu/OcularMicrobiome/Consortium_data/PITT/" + df["sample_name"].astype(str) + ".unmapped.fastq.gz>" + df["non_human_reads"].astype(str)  + "</a>"

show(
    df,
    paging=True,
    pageLength=10,
    scrollX=True,
    classes="display compact",
    layout={
        "topStart": ["buttons"],
        "topEnd": ["search"],
        "bottomStart": ["pageLength"],
        "bottomEnd": ["paging"] ,
    },
    buttons=["colvis"],
    allow_html=True,
    #columnDefs=[{"targets": "_all", "render": "function(data, type) { return type === 'display' && data !== null && data !== '' && !isNaN(data) ? Number(data).toLocaleString('en-US') : data; }"}]
)
```
